title: Scalar-restricted constant support projection

from.place: proof step identifying the scalar-restricted support mate with the constant projection

statement: For finite commutative rings A and B, a ring map A → B, a compactification c of f : X → Y, an ambient support adjunction for A, and K in the derived category of pro-etale A-module sheaves on X, the constant-coefficient projection for the scalar-restricted coefficient object B is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 0GL6, projection formula for the scalar-restricted constant coefficient

proof.text: The fixed support functor is a left adjoint under the ambient support adjunction and therefore preserves the discrete colimits required by the constant-support projection theorem; apply that theorem to the scalar-restricted constant coefficient object.

proof_origin: Strictly componentwise intermediate result used by the arrow-isomorphism transport in the parent theorem.
